---
name: Feature request
about: Describe an unmet product need.
---

Do not include credentials, private data, raw service responses, or personal configuration.

## User need

Describe the unmet need and who would benefit. A need can be reported without proposing a method.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the observable behavior you would like, if you have a proposal.

## Alternatives and limitations

Describe alternatives you considered and their limitations.

## Validation method (for research-dependent features)

Only if your proposal claims a new method: describe the method, evaluation protocol,
and reproducible evidence. This section is not required to describe a need alone.
